    Portfolio

    Open Source Repositories

    Published: October 25, 2026

    • Fast Multi-robot Exploration
      Decentralized multi-robot exploration framework for coordinating teams of UAVs in forest environments.
    • SMB Path Planner
      Autonomous path planning pipeline deployed on the Super Mega Bot (SMB) platform during the ETH Zurich Robotics Summer School.
    • Multi-robot Coordination
      A hierarchical global path-planning framework for multi-robot systems, enabling coordinated trajectory generation for fleets of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs).
    • Pose-graph Backend
      A multi-agent sensor fusion engine leveraging optimization-based pose-graph backends to support distributed multi-robot path planning.
    • Multirotors Landing
      A deep reinforcement learning (RL) pipeline for autonomous multi-rotor UAV landing, leveraging multimodal semantic scene segmentation and depth inputs to identify safe landing zones.
    • Pointcloud Utilities
      A collection of modular ROS nodes designed for real-time 3D point cloud processing, transformation, and spatial data handling.
